stratum.description: Must match the directory the case is filed under. 'fixture' is the committed fabricated case; s1 = historical plan with injected defects, s2 = historical plan whose implementation later hit plan-visible trouble, s3 = clean negative control.

base_sha.description: Repo state the plan was written against. Real cases pin a full SHA; the committed fixture uses HEAD so shallow clones can materialize it.

plan.description: Plan document, relative to the case directory (must not escape it).

file.description: Repo file the defect concerns, or plan.md for plan-internal defects.

expected_severity.description: NEUTRAL vocabulary only (see DECISION_RULE.md) — never CRITICAL/MEDIUM/LOW or P0-P3, so neither engine's native scale leaks into grading.

allow_severities.description: On a negative control: findings at these severities are acceptable; anything above is a false positive.

notes.description: Grading context. For s2 cases, record the hindsight-bias control: the defect must be visible in the plan text, not only in the implementation outcome.
